shared_elements: low-relief carving on stone with raised motifs against a recessed ground
curvilinear schematic motifs with rounded corners
justification: A is a flat panel covered edge to edge with a grid of rectangular glyph-like cartouches in rows and columns, whereas B is a three-dimensional anthropomorphic figure with a head, shoulders and torso bearing a few large isolated motifs (paired eyes/discs, a central ring, an arc band). The only real correspondence is the shared convention of shallow relief with rounded, curvilinear schematic forms; there is no shared scene, no shared arrangement, and no shared specific motif.
